{{Top|leg}}
A '''Star Ranger''' was a type of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that existed by [[44 ABY]]. That year, [[Abeloth]], in the guise of [[Lydea Pagorski]], [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] a Star Ranger through the [[Home Fleet (Imperial Remnant)|Imperial Remnant]] [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] of [[Exodo II]] to reach [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala]]. [[Jagged Fel]] thought that the feat impossible to achieve, speculating that a disloyal individual in his [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] had allowed the [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] to ignore the presence of the Star Ranger, but later realized with the input of [[Tahiri Veila]] that it must be the doing of Abeloth using [[Force-flash]].
